status: Owner-selected release targets and orchestration; expanded narrative/frontier direction

overrides.requirement: Provide an almost-infinite-feeling frontier through practically unbounded addressable continuation, coherent history/ecology/cultures, meaningful systemic variability and persistent discoveries; validate seamless loading at supported travel speeds without repetitive filler or erasing mutations.
overrides.status: Owner reinforced No Man's Sky loading and Dwarf Fortress variability as guides

overrides.requirement: Godot/C#, bounded Wait-style on-field combat, desktop launch on Windows/macOS/Linux and 1–4 hosted players are selected; validate exact toolchain/OS versions, minimum hardware, qualification budgets and the detailed contracts in the final technical specification. Mobile is a later supported phase.
overrides.status: Owner-selected targets distinguished from technical qualification

additions.requirement: Require Windows, macOS and Linux for the first production release, with Android/iOS mobile support delivered and validated in a later supported phase; retain Godot/C# and avoid a disposable parallel implementation.
Guarantee solo and 1–4 simultaneous players per hosted world for the first production release; validate separated exploration and shared encounters without weakening NPC depth.

Orchestrate engine builders, content/asset creators, dedicated artists, virtual playtesters and independent critic agents from the central collaboration task; use the GameDev ecosystem only where it improves the work and preserve human art/enjoyment acceptance.

Provide a complete implementation plan through production, with cumulative retained vertical slices, requirement-to-phase and validation coverage, full content assimilation, explicit dependencies and no scope lost through staging.

Combine contextual random encounters, authored adventurelets and encounter decks for coherent procedural play, respecting actual world state, inhabitants, resources, knowledge, pacing and persistent outcomes.

Allow multiple seed-grounded grand narrative possibilities to emerge, coexist, intersect, diverge and resolve through the world, including but not limited to a dark lord; pursue Dwarf Fortress-like meaningful systemic variability rather than cosmetic recombination alone.

Provide day/night and daily rest/sleep pacing, initially targeting roughly 40 minutes for a full day/night cycle; tune through playtests so camping is not a frequent chore, and apply explicit multiplayer time-advance, fatigue and interruption rules.
additions.status: Owner pacing proposal; full-cycle interpretation recorded; numerical target requires playtest acceptance

additions.requirement: Make campsites, inns and caravan/party rest meaningful places for watches, cooking, pet/mount care, maintenance, research, skills, relationships, stories and contextual encounter/combat/events, with actual resources, work, security and persistent consequences.
